notes: This is the only family in 33 records to show a coherent signal, and it is also the only one with substantial published academic support in crypto. The test cannot confirm it: the detection limit is around 1.6 annualised Sharpe and the observed effect is roughly 0.7.

SW-0035, embargoed until 2029-06-30, is the holdout test — and its pre-registration states up front that it is underpowered. Confirming a true Sharpe of 0.72 at z=2 with 80% power needs roughly 136,000 hourly bars, about 15.6 years. Four years gives about 29%.
confirmatory: Pre-registered test: does the best of 90 cross-sectional momentum variants clear DSR 0.95? Verdict: NO. DSR 0.809 — the closest any sweep in this registry has come, and still short.
exploratory: 96% of variants were positive with a median annualised Sharpe of 0.51 and a best of 0.98 against an expected-under-null of 0.64. The family behaves as one thing rather than as a spread of better and worse rules.

PBO is 0.479, near the 0.5 coin-flip line. Choosing among these 90 variants carries almost no information out of sample. That is consistent with a uniform family-wide effect and inconsistent with some variants genuinely being better.

The effect comes from the stable end of the universe, not the volatile end. Splitting by symbol lifetime: 81 long-lived symbols (>40,000 bars) give a net Sharpe of 0.72, while 55 short-lived symbols (<20,000 bars) give 0.04. A spurious altcoin-volatility artefact would show the opposite, and the effect is stronger where liquidity is better.

Post hoc observation, carried forward to the replacement sweeps: the mean_touch exit rule is long-only with gross exposure 2.0, not dollar-neutral, so it is not market-neutral and does inherit the crypto trend. In all three sweeps the highest-Sharpe variant came from this branch. In SW-0034 that variant compounds to 0.22x of initial capital with a 100% maximum drawdown despite an annualised Sharpe of 0.989, losing between 37% and 53% in each of four hours during the LUNA/UST collapse (2022-05-11 to 2022-05-13; verified against BTCUSDT bar timestamps, not a data error). Sharpe and the deflated Sharpe ratio are computed from arithmetic moments and do not see the capital path.
reason: Weight-allocation bug in sweep/cross_sectional.py: assets outside the point-in-time universe scored -inf and therefore sorted first, so the entire short leg of every long_short variant (45 of 90) was allocated to non-investable assets whose returns are zeroed. Verified by replay: the stored returns matrix reproduces exactly under the buggy allocator (max abs diff 2.6e-08) and diverges materially under the fixed one (correlation 0.54-0.69; one variant moves from 0.187 to 0.468 annualised Sharpe). The mean_touch (long-only) branch was unaffected, but the corrupted variants are counted in n_trials, in the expected-maximum-Sharpe null and in the PBO combinatorics, so the primary metric is not valid. Pre-registration and its Bitcoin timestamp remain valid; only the execution failed. Fixed and covered by tests/test_cross_sectional_weights.py; re-registered under new IDs.
